pushA:shoulder-press.coach: Stay at 15 kg and aim for 6: you got 5 and 5 after a short night, and if 5 again, use 12.5 kg.

pushA:incline-db-press.coach: Stay at 10 kg and aim for 9 or more: every set was 8.

pushA:cable-lateral.coach: Lighter: 10 kg gave only 4 to 6, so use 5 kg dumbbells until a light cable works, left arm first.

pushA:chest-fly.coach: Stay at 30 kg: the second set was 8, so aim for 12 on both.

pushA:triceps-pushdown.coach: Stay at 25 kg and aim for 11 or more: every set was 10.

pushA:db-lateral.coach: Up one step to 4 kg: both sets went past 20.

pullA:pull-up.coach: Work at 30 kg on every set: it gave 12 once, and at 10 on all sets go to 35 kg.

pullA:cable-row.coach: Stay at 20 kg and aim for 11 or more: every set was 10.

pullA:straight-arm-pulldown.coach: Stay at 20 kg and aim for 13 or more: every set was 12.

pullA:reverse-fly.coach: Lighter at 5 kg: 10 kg gave only 6, and stop if the shoulder hurts.

pullA:cable-lateral.coach: Lighter: 10 kg gave only 4 to 6, so use 5 kg dumbbells until a light cable works, left arm first.

pullA:curl.coach: Stay at 5 kg with longer rests: sets fell to 7, 6 and 4.

legsA:leg-press.coach: Stay on the empty sled and aim for 12 on every set, then add the first plates.

legsA:rdl.coach: Stay at 20 kg on the cable: the first set was 6, so aim for 10 on all three.

legsA:leg-curl.coach: Stay at 20 kg and aim for 11 or more: every set was 10.

legsA:leg-extension.coach: Stay at 10 kg, slow, and aim for 12, and drop it if the spot below the left kneecap hurts.

legsA:standing-calf.coach: Stay at 20 kg and aim for 11 or more: both sets were 10.

legsA:hanging-knee-raise.coach: Aim for 11 or more: both sets were 10.

pushB:incline-press.coach: First time: start light, about the empty 20 kg bar or a light machine setting, for 6 to 10 reps with 2 left.

pushB:shoulder-press.coach: Use 12.5 kg and aim for 8: this day asks 8 to 12, and 15 kg gave only 5.

pushB:db-lateral.coach: Up one step to 4 kg: 3 kg went to 25 on Push A.

pushB:dips.coach: First time: bodyweight dips leaning forward, and if 8 does not come, use the chest press machine.

pushB:overhead-triceps.coach: First time: pick about 15 kg, lighter than your 25 kg pushdown, and aim for 10 to 15.

pushB:cable-lateral.coach: No working light cable, so do these 2 sets with 4 kg dumbbells, left arm first.

pullB:lat-pulldown.coach: First time: about 30 kg, your best on Pull A, for 8 to 12 with 2 reps left.

pullB:chest-supported-row.coach: First time: start light, near your 20 kg cable row, and find a weight you can row about 10 times.

pullB:one-arm-row.coach: First time: pick a dumbbell you can row 10 to 12 times per arm with 2 left, left arm first.

pullB:face-pull.coach: First time: the lightest working cable, about 10 kg, for 15 to 20 slow reps, and stop if the shoulder hurts.

pullB:cable-lateral.coach: Lighter: 10 kg gave only 4 to 6, so use 5 kg dumbbells until a light cable works, left arm first.

pullB:hammer-curl.coach: First time: pick dumbbells you can curl about 12 times with 2 reps left.

legsB:split-squat.coach: First time: bodyweight or light dumbbells for 8 to 12 per leg, and stop if the knee spot hurts.

legsB:hip-thrust.coach: First time: start light on the machine and add weight until 8 to 12 leaves 2 reps.

legsB:leg-curl.coach: Stay at 20 kg and aim for 11 or more: every set was 10.

legsB:seated-calf.coach: First time: about 20 kg, like your standing calf raise, for 12 to 20 slow reps.

legsB:hanging-leg-raise.coach: First time: bodyweight with legs as straight as you can, and bend the knees if 10 does not come.

cable-lateral.note: No cable machine has a working 5 kg setting.
The 5 kg cable setting did not work.

reverse-fly.note: Shoulder pain on the first set.
